card: This pull request raises the minimum supported Clang compiler version to 19.0 and Xcode Command Line Tools to 26.3. It allows new codebase changes to rely on C++20 Class Template Argument Deduction for alias templates and drop workarounds for older Clang bugs. The change updates CI environments, CMake C++ feature checks, and documentation, while setting clang-format to the latest standard.
evidence: PR description: 'Most supported operating systems ship with clang-19 (or later), so bump the minimum to that and allow new code to drop workarounds for previous clang bugs. (For this bump, only C++20 CTAD will become available.)'
problem: Supporting older Clang versions requires keeping workarounds for past compiler bugs and prevents developers from using newer C++20 features like CTAD for alias templates.
scope_notes: Combines the general Clang 19 bump with a minimum Xcode CLT bump to 26.3 (referencing PR #36287), a CI runner image change, and a clang-format configuration update.
summary: Bumps the minimum supported Clang version to 19.0 and Xcode Command Line Tools to 26.3 across documentation, CMake, and CI configurations. It updates CMake's C++ feature detection to verify support for C++20 Class Template Argument Deduction (CTAD) for alias templates rather than aggregates, and configures clang-format to use the latest standard.
